title: Nixon used Malmgren to check Kissinger
summary: Matthew Pines tells of Nixon used Malmgren to check Kissinger, about 1969-1974 at Washington, D.C., and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: like Malmrren was used explicitly by Nixon to check Kissinger in many negotiations to like confirm that Kissinger wasn't going rogue on various things

plain: Researcher Matthew Pines told podcast host Jesse Michels that President Richard Nixon used a trade official named Harold Malmgren to keep an eye on Henry Kissinger, his top foreign policy aide, in many negotiations. According to Pines, Malmgren's job was to confirm that Kissinger was not going rogue, which would make Malmgren a trusted insider worth listening to.
